status: PLAN ONLY — no model has been trained and no existing dataset has been modified by this change-set.
description: Future fine-tuning change-set plan for the PAKISTAN + FOREIGN COUNTRIES / OVERSEAS PAKISTANIS knowledge layer. This file is a proposal describing what WOULD be added to the supervised fine-tuning corpus the next time training data is regenerated. It is intentionally NOT wired into server/generateFineTuneDataset.js, so running the current generator produces the identical V1 dataset (train/validation/test, incl. the held-out 433-example test.jsonl). Nothing here retrains a model or contaminates the current evaluation set.
central_principle: A Pakistani asking about a matter that involves another country must not be answered as if only Pakistani law applies. The applicable jurisdiction is decided by context, and Pakistan-facing guidance (Layer A) is kept strictly separate from foreign official procedure (Layer B).

v1_baseline.domains: Constitution, PPC, CrPC, CPC, PECA, Family, Property, Tenancy, Labour, Consumer, Education, Legal Aid, Court Procedure, Case Law, Documents, General, Immigration
v1_baseline.location: rag/training/*.jsonl generated from server/fineTuneData/ content banks

no_contamination_guarantees: DO NOT modify or regenerate the existing held-out test.jsonl (433 examples). The cross-border examples live in a SEPARATE, currently-unused file until a future, explicitly-approved dataset rebuild.

DO NOT delete or edit any server/fineTuneData/ V1 file, the rag/documents/ V1 corpus, or the RAG index. The cross-border corpus is additive and already registered separately (see rag/manifest.json cross_border_* docs).

When the dataset is eventually rebuilt to include cross-border, the existing near-duplicate union-find and forced-test collision checks in generateFineTuneDataset.js MUST run first: any cross-border example within Jaccard >= 0.9 of an existing held-out test item is rejected (test-set contamination guard).

Uploaded personal foreign documents (court notices, visas, contracts belonging to a user) MUST NEVER enter the training corpus or the public RAG corpus. Only de-identified, officially-sourced procedural records are eligible.

Every source_ref must resolve against the verified RAG corpus (server/fineTuneData/refs.js resolveRef) or the generator ABORTS — no fabricated sections, treaties, fees, URLs, embassy details, or university requirements.
jurisdiction_teaching_goals: Never default to Pakistani law merely because the user is Pakistani; identify the forum/authority named in the query.
Layer A vs Layer B separation: Pakistan-side policy/consular/procedure vs foreign-country official procedure, presented as distinct and never merged.

No false universality: never claim coverage of 'all countries'. The required framing is 'Insaaf provides verified Pakistan-facing cross-border guidance for the countries and topics covered by its current official-source corpus.'

Time-sensitive facts (visa fees, processing times, hotline numbers, deadlines, country lists) are deferred to the live official source with a verification date and status, not asserted as static truth.
Safety-first routing for distress abroad (arrest, trafficking, abandoned worker, lost passport) toward the nearest Pakistani mission and verified national helplines without inventing numbers.
Language rule: reply in English or Roman Urdu; final legal documents only in English or Urdu script (never Roman Urdu).

cross_border_additions.rationale: Core scenario: a Pakistani (in Pakistan or abroad) receives a summons/notice/judgment from a foreign court. The model must recognise the foreign forum, avoid Pakistani civil/criminal procedure, and give jurisdiction-aware next steps.
example_types: US court summons received -> identify foreign jurisdiction, advise local foreign-qualified counsel + response deadline, note Pakistan CPC does not govern
Foreign judgment enforcement in Pakistan -> recognition/enforcement limits, not automatic effect
Service of process abroad -> cross-border service channel, no assumption Pakistani procedure applies
Refusal to fabricate the foreign statute/fee; defer to the named court's official source

cross_border_additions.rationale: Most-frequent Pakistan-facing cross-border need; must route to Pakistan-side emigration protections AND the foreign country's labour authority as two separate layers.
example_types: Saudi/Gulf employer unpaid wages -> Layer A: BE&OE/Protector of Emigrants, recruiting-agent licence, POEA-equivalent complaint channel; Layer B: foreign labour ministry, not Pakistani labour law alone
Passport confiscated by employer -> consular + emigration authority, safety-first
Recruiting-agent verification before departure -> licensed-agent check, avoid trafficking
Trafficking / abandoned-worker indicators -> emergency consular repatriation routing

cross_border_additions.rationale: Lost passport, emergency travel document, attestation/apostille, visa no-guarantee framing; official-mission lookup without invented contact details.
example_types: Lost passport abroad -> emergency certificate / new passport via mission + NADRA/DGIP, no fabricated embassy phone number
Document attestation vs apostille -> MOFA attestation process; foreign-country acceptance verified against official source
Visa application general steps -> 'no guarantee' framing, official embassy/consulate channel only
Find the correct Pakistani mission (embassy vs high commission vs consulate)

cross_border_additions.rationale: Foreign marriage/divorce recognition, custody jurisdiction, overseas inheritance/property, dual nationality/NICOP/POC — recognition in Pakistan is the Pakistan-facing question.
example_types: Foreign divorce -> recognition conditions in Pakistan + NADRA/registration, distinct from the foreign decree itself
Cross-border child custody -> which forum has jurisdiction; no unilateral assumption
Inheritance/property spanning Pakistan + abroad -> separate the two jurisdictions, POA use
Dual nationality / NICOP / POC -> Pakistan Citizenship Act permitted-countries framing, list verified against official source

cross_border_additions.rationale: HEC degree attestation, foreign-university equivalence, student-visa basics, official scholarships only — never invent university requirements or scholarships.
example_types: HEC degree attestation for foreign use -> process + HEC official source
Equivalence of a foreign degree -> HEC recognised-institution check, no fabrication
Student visa basics -> 'no guarantee', official immigration channel
Scholarships -> official government programs only, direct to the verified portal, no invented awards

cross_border_additions.rationale: Users ask whether a treaty/extradition/MLA applies; must reference MOFA/institutional process and never assert specific treaty contents not in the corpus.
example_types: Is there extradition between Pakistan and country X -> explain channel via MOFA, verify against official source, no invented treaty
Mutual legal assistance basics -> state-to-state process, not a private remedy
Treaty registration / bilateral agreement overview

cross_border_additions.rationale: Teach the model to say what it does NOT cover instead of guessing a foreign rule, and to state the exact coverage framing.
example_types: Query about an uncovered country/topic -> honest coverage-boundary statement + direct to live official source
Request for a specific visa fee / processing time -> defer to official source with verification date, refuse to invent
Request to 'just apply Pakistani law' to a foreign forum -> correct the jurisdiction assumption politely
Statement of the standard coverage sentence (no 'all countries' claim)

data_format: Same JSONL schema as V1 (instruction, input, output, language, domain, task, source_refs). Proposed new domain value 'cross_border'; proposed tasks: 'cross_border_jurisdiction', 'consular_assistance', 'overseas_employment', 'study_abroad', 'cross_border_family_property', 'cross_border_recognition', 'coverage_boundary_refusal'.
integration_point_when_approved: server/generateFineTuneDataset.js: import the new cross_border bank, add 'cross_border' to VALID_DOMAINS and the proposed tasks to VALID_TASKS, and append via add({...}, 'CROSS_BORDER'). Held-out cross-border refusal/coverage examples should be marked forceTest so they land in a NEW quarantined test partition, not the existing 433-example file.
holdout_strategy: A dedicated cross-border held-out set (foreign-forum triage + coverage-boundary refusals, ~40 examples) is kept out of training to measure jurisdiction correctness without ever editing the existing V1 test.jsonl.
constraints: DO NOT retrain or run any training now — this is a data plan only.
DO NOT overwrite rag/training/*.jsonl (esp. the 433-example test.jsonl) or any server/fineTuneData V1 file.
New examples go to a NEW file (cross_border_changeset.jsonl); combine V1 + cross-border only at an explicitly-approved future dataset rebuild.
Every example's source_refs must resolve against the rebuilt cross-border RAG corpus (npm run rag:build) or the generator aborts.
URLs inside outputs must already appear in the corpus (server/fineTuneData/refs.js URL_ALLOWED_DOMAINS / checkUrls); otherwise use a plain authority name with no link.
No fabricated foreign law, visa/immigration rules, university requirements, jobs, scholarships, treaties, embassies, phone numbers, fees, or URLs.
Never merge Layer A (Pakistan) and Layer B (foreign) into one 'applicable law' claim; keep them labelled and separate.
Uploaded personal foreign documents are excluded from training and from the public RAG corpus.
